markdown_content: # 3D Snapshot Colorway Options in Clo 2025.0 This document explains the new colorway export features in the 3D Snapshot tool of Clo 2025.0, detailing how to select and manage colorways for both single and multi-view snapshots during export. ## Overview of 3D Snapshot Colorway Export Clo 2025.0 introduces enhanced colorway options when exporting 3D Snapshots. Users can now specify exactly which colorways to include in their snapshots, whether exporting a single view or multiple views simultaneously. This feature provides greater control over the presentation and documentation of garment designs. ## Accessing the Colorway Options in 3D Snapshot Export To utilize the colorway export options: 1. Navigate to **File > Snapshot > 3D Window**. 2. Choose between **Single View** or **Multi-View** snapshot types. 3. In the snapshot export dialog, locate the **Colorway** dropdown menu. The colorway dropdown offers the following choices: - **Current All**: Exports all existing colorways applied to the garment. - **Custom**: Allows manual selection of specific colorways to include in the export. ## Selecting Specific Colorways for Export When choosing the **Custom** option: - A selection interface appears showing all available colorways. - Users can check or uncheck individual colorways to include or exclude them. - This is useful, for example, to export all colorways except for a specific one (e.g., excluding white). After selection: - Confirm the choices by clicking **OK**. - Proceed to save the snapshot with the chosen colorways applied. ## Managing Colorways in Multi-View Snapshots The same colorway selection process applies when exporting **Multi-View** snapshots: - In the multi-view snapshot export dialog, the **Colorway** option is available. - Users can select **Custom** and edit their colorway selection using the dropdown. - The "Edit Colorway" option allows reviewing and modifying the chosen colorways before saving. - Selecting **Select All** includes every colorway across all views. This flexibility enables comprehensive presentations showcasing multiple viewpoints and selected colorways in one export. ## Summary Clo 2025.0’s 3D Snapshot export now supports fine-grained colorway selection for both single and multi-view snapshots. Users can export all or a custom set of colorways, improving the versatility and clarity of design presentations. The interface is accessible via **File > Snapshot > 3D Window**, with intuitive dropdown menus for colorway management and editing prior to saving snapshots.
